lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Review round 1 filed 3 fix stories against the commit-existence gate epic (CAM-187). This story (US-R1-002, priority 2, CRITICAL, src/supervisor/host.ts:626 pre-fix line number) fixed commitExistsForStory: it previously ran `git log --format=%s <branch>` which walks the branch's ENTIRE ancestry back to the root commit (per git-scm.com/docs/git-log, confirmed at Step 5.5), not just commits unique to this PRD/branch. Story ids (US-001..) are reused every PRD, so an ancient bracketless commit from an unrelated past PRD (e.g. 'feat: US-001 - tmux worker-slot primitives', months old) collided and made the gate return true unconditionally regardless of whether the CURRENT worker actually committed -- silently defeating the exact 'passes:true but no commit' scenario the epic (CAM-187) exists to catch. Fix: scoped the git log range to `origin/main..HEAD` (double-dot range syntax: commits reachable from HEAD but not from origin/main, i.e. commits unique to this branch since it forked from main), refreshed via a best-effort `git fetch origin main` (ignored on failure: offline/no-remote), falling back to local `main..HEAD` when `git rev-parse origin/main` fails (e.g. real-git integration test tmpdirs with no remote configured). Verified empirically against this repo's own git history: `git log --format=%s origin/main..HEAD` returns exactly this branch's 8 commits (US-001/US-002/US-003/US-R1-001 feat+chore pairs plus the audited-prd chore), none of the old unrelated US-001/002/003 commits from prior PRDs leak in. Raised the file-size ratchet ceiling for host.ts (769->797; content.split('\n').length is wc -l + 1 for files with trailing newline, per patterns.md) with a tracker-ref in scripts/file-size-budget.json._ref. One fix story remains: US-R1-003 (priority 3, WARNING, test/supervisor/result.test.ts:1283 pre-fix line number) wants (a) a commitSubjectMatchesStory matcher test for the bracketed 'feat: [US-001] - Title' convention (NOTE: this was ALREADY added in US-R1-001, so re-check test/supervisor/result.test.ts before assuming it's still missing) and (b) an integration test that runs the REAL host.ts commitExistsForStory adapter (not the injected fake used by loop.test.ts/result.test.ts) against a real git repo whose only matching commit is bracketed, exercising both the US-R1-001 matcher fix AND this story's git-log-scoping fix together. Suggest a real-git integration test pattern per patterns.md 'Real-git integration test pattern' bullet (mkdtempSync + git init + git config user.email/user.name + commit a bracketed 'feat: [US-XXX] - Title' commit + assert commitExistsForStory returns true and does NOT match an unrelated ancient commit made before a fake 'origin/main' merge-base). Read the story's own `notes` field (no acceptanceCriteria array on these fix stories).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed <ref1>..<ref2> double-dot range syntax shows commits reachable from ref2 but not ref1 (equivalent to 'git log ref2 ^ref1'); origin/main..HEAD is the correct idiom to scope to commits unique to this branch since it forked from main. Verified empirically against this repo's own history too.
